criteria.requirement: Extend actual dynaconf list CLI with repeatable --match glob patterns over top-level canonical key names, case-insensitive union without duplicates. Apply after existing env/loader selection on a detached dictionary and consistently to text/JSON/output-file views; empty matches return valid empty data, not a fake missing-key failure. Reject combining --match with old --key explicitly while preserving legacy no-pattern/single-key behavior. Use fnmatch semantics, never arbitrary eval/regex rewriting, and do not mutate settings or loader history during filtering.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
